capabilities.description: Build-manifest bookkeeping only, not a security gate — corrected 2026-09-15 per independent review. tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver's HTTP automation server starts purely from Cargo.toml's `e2e-testing` feature flag being compiled in (src/lib.rs's #[cfg(feature = "e2e-testing")]); this capability entry authorizes nothing at runtime, it exists only so Tauri's build-time validation of every capabilities/ file against the compiled plugin set doesn't fail once the plugin exists (confirmed empirically: a standalone e2e-testing.json file broke the plain `cargo check` with 'Permission wdio-webdriver:default not found' even with tauri.conf.json's capabilities restricted to ["default"]). Inlining it here, read only via --config, is bookkeeping convenience, not the thing that keeps this out of a release build — Cargo.toml's own comment on this dependency is the real control.
